review_pass_1: Internal scientific/scope review: compared current official CSIR syllabi and archived SET, checked primary abstract records for Barton/Poethig, Friml, Van den Berg, Lockhart and supporting reviews. Recomputed wall rates .08/.04/.05 h^-1, root flux 960/960/900/900/540 µm/h, exponential 12.214 mm, logarithmic .173287/day, cell balance 55/66, 4 initiation events. All mandatory roadmap microtopics addressed. Distinguishes response versus concentration, lineage versus fate, cell volume versus longitudinal output, determinacy versus arrest.
review_pass_2: Separate internal teaching and static QA: expanded original draft from approximately 5728 to 14651 words across 148 unique paragraphs, compared adjacent 5.D.02 (13733 words); inspected all 50 answer keys, explanations and SVG titles/descriptions/labels; checked anchors, ARIA, unique IDs, reader script syntax, direct and dynamic navigation. No external reviewer or interactive browser.
